deals.description: 🇧🇬 60 YEARS OF MUSIC, DANCE & TRADITION 🎶 Music connects generations. Culture connects people. On 10 October 2026, Vienna will host: GUSLARCHE – HERITAGE 60 Years of Dance, Music & Song Celebrating the 60th anniversary of the Children & Youth Folklore Ensemble “Guslarche” from Gorna Oryahovitsa, Bulgaria, this special concert brings together generations of artists to celebrate Bulgarian folklore, music and traditions. ❤️ Why are we sharing this with our WPCF community? In 2026, we were delighted to welcome three Bulgarian choirs to the World Peace Choral Festival. Among them was the Kikta Choir from Bulgarische Rhythmen kitka.vienna , a long-standing friend of our festival who joins us every summer. deals.description: Seeking new friends? Bored on a Viennese Sunday? We know regular "meet new people" events are stressfull and you have already swiped your fingers to the bone, let's just take the pressure off and enjoy a bit of naughty banter. Join us at Vienna’s cosiest rooftop bar—right in the heart of the city at the iconic 25hours Hotel—for a night of fun, flirting, making new friends and full-on laughter! 🎤 Improv & Stand-Up Comedy Special Expect wild dating stories, awkward mishaps, and unexpected twists—all served with a side of sass and spontaneity. 💥 Get 20% Off Drinks! Sign up and receive an exclusive drink voucher on entry with your ticket on entry. We will hand out drinksvoucher between 18.15 and 19.00 for you to get a drink at the bar! Show starts at 19.00 ✨ Hosted by the charming Berk Cayci. Special guest comedian& magician Balint Villei. 🎟 Donation-based entry – Cards accepted. #viennaevents #sundaysinvienna #dating #meetupvienna #meetnewfriends
